part_bounding_box_mm.note: From MOTOR MOUNT_features.json. CAD axes: X=short dim, Y=long dim, Z=height.

settings.part_orientation_on_machine: Long axis (Y=104mm) along machine X-axis; short axis (X=55mm) gripped by vise in machine Y
settings.notes: Outer profile contoured with 12mm EM from Z+0.4 down to Z-21mm (full part height). XY symmetric → center zero. Z22.5mm clearance just exceeds part height (21.5mm). Stock header says +0.10mm (not 10mm). STOCK on outer profile, not floor reference.

settings.z_zero_interpretation: top_of_part (machined datum from setting 1 side, now exposed top after flip)
settings.inferred_clamped_face: +X / -X (vise jaws grip the short 55mm dimension after flip so long axis is still along X)
settings.datum_face: bottom face (machined face from setting 1 - now rest face on vise/parallels)
settings.setup_to_setup_relationship: Part flipped 180° about long axis. Setting 1 machined top becomes setting 2 bottom. Setting 1 machined bottom face (Z0 from setting 1) is now sitting on parallels. Setting 2 Z0 = newly exposed top face being face-milled from Z10.802 down to Z0.
settings.notes: Z clearance 100mm (high due to elevated part on parallels after flip, and taller fixture stack). Face mill cuts 10.802mm from raw stock down to final top surface. Then performs 2D pocket and bore operations. Same G54 code - vendor resets offsets between settings.

settings.z_zero_interpretation: top_of_part (machined side face - probe from +X face)
settings.xy_zero_interpretation: center_of_part (X and Y symmetric in tool coords)
settings.inferred_clamped_face: -Z / +Y (part standing upright or on angle plate, gripping previously machined faces)
settings.setup_to_setup_relationship: Part repositioned to access a side face. Small central bore/pocket (r~3mm) machined. Likely the +X face of the part. Only 2 programs → minor finishing operations.
settings.notes: Z clearance 100mm. Tool operates very close to center (X1.162, Y-2.905 first move), suggesting a bore or pocket near part center on the side face. Very short program compared to settings 1 and 2.

key_findings.wcs_origin: All settings use G54 - vendor resets G54 offset table between settings on the machine. Not G55/G56.
key_findings.xy_zero_strategy: All settings are CENTER zero (XY symmetric toolpaths). Part center of mass/bounding box = WCS X0Y0.
key_findings.z_zero_strategy: Setting 1: top of raw stock. Settings 2+3: top of previously machined face (probed off datum).
key_findings.fixture_reuse: Same vise used for all settings. Jaw opening consistent ~65mm for settings 1 and 2 (55mm part + 5mm each side clearance, rounded to 65mm).
key_findings.clamping_sequence: Setting 1: raw billet in vise, long axis along machine X. Setting 2: flip part (long axis still X), new top face up. Setting 3: rotate to access side face via angle plate or re-orient in vise.
key_findings.parallels_evidence: Z clearance jumps from 22.5mm (setting 1) to 100mm (settings 2+3) despite part being same size. Extra clearance is due to parallels raising the part higher in the vise for settings 2+3 to ensure jaw clearance below machined features.
key_findings.soft_jaws_not_used: Standard hard jaws used throughout. Part outer profile is simple enough (rectangular billet) that hard jaws work for settings 1+2. Setting 3 likely uses angle plate or custom stop rather than soft jaws.
